name: shadowsofdoubt-modmaker
description: Tooling for the Shadows of Doubt Mod Maker. The app itself is zero-build static files; npm is only needed to run tests and the local dev server.

scripts.cert: test -f cert.pem -a -f key.pem || openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365 -subj '/CN=localhost' 2>/dev/null && echo 'Self-signed cert ready (cert.pem, key.pem).'
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:playwright
